  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    :root {
      /* Source: https://hypertask.ai homepage CSS (.h1x, .h1-btn-primary), fetched 2026-10-25. */
      --ht-p1: #000000;
      --ht-p2: #0b0b0d;
      --ht-ink: #f4f4f7;
      --ht-ink-2: rgba(244, 244, 247, 0.64);
      --ht-ink-3: rgba(244, 244, 247, 0.40);
      --ht-line: rgba(244, 244, 247, 0.10);
      --ht-line-2: rgba(244, 244, 247, 0.16);
      --ht-btn-bg: #ffffff;
      --ht-btn-fg: #000000;
      --ht-btn-hover: #d9d9d9;
      --ht-radius-btn: 8px;
      --ht-radius-lg: 14px;
      --ht-font-display: "Newsreader", Georgia, serif;
      --ht-font-body: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      --ht-font-wordmark: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;

      --ht-secondary: #262626;
      --page-bg: #000000;
      --surface: #0b0b0d;
      --surface-hover: #191a1e;
      --ink: var(--ht-ink);
      --muted: #a7a8ad;
      --surface-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
      --divider: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
      --chat-bg: var(--ht-secondary);
      --chat-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
      --primary-hover: var(--ht-btn-hover);
      --secondary-hover: #3a3a42;
      --btn-bg: var(--ht-btn-bg);
      --btn-fg: var(--ht-btn-fg);
      --radius-btn: var(--ht-radius-btn);
      --radius-lg: var(--ht-radius-lg);
      --font-display: var(--ht-font-display);
      --font-body: var(--ht-font-body);
      --font-wordmark: var(--ht-font-wordmark);
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      background: var(--page-bg);
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.6;
      min-height: 100vh;
    }

    /* Site Header - Floating Rounded (Homepage Style) */
    .site-header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 20px;
      z-index: 1000;
      width: calc(100% - 40px);
      max-width: 1344px;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
      background: var(--page-bg);
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      border-radius: 12px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,.1);
      transition: border-color 0.3s;
    }
    .site-header.scrolled { border-color: var(--divider); }

    .site-header-content {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 56px;
    }

    .site-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .site-logo img { width: 28px; height: 28px; object-fit: cover; object-position: left center; }
    .site-logo::after { content: 'Hypertask'; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-wordmark); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; }

    .site-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .site-nav-link {
      color: var(--muted);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .site-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
    .site-nav-link.active { color: var(--ink); }

    .site-header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }

    .site-btn-login {
      color: var(--ink);
      background: var(--surface-hover);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .site-btn-login:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--secondary-hover); }

    .site-btn-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--btn-bg);
      color: var(--btn-fg);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .site-btn-cta:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); }

    .mobile-menu-btn {
      display: none;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--ink);
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .site-header { width: calc(100% - 16px); top: 10px; }
      .site-header-content { padding: 0 16px; height: 48px; }
      .site-nav { display: none; }
      .site-btn-login { display: none; }
      .mobile-menu-btn { display: block; }
    }

    /* Hero — compact so the search and first category row fit a 1280x720 help page */
    .hero {
      background: var(--page-bg);
      padding: 12px 24px 8px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .hero-content { max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .hero h1 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 42px;
      font-weight: 500;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }
    .hero .subtitle { color: var(--muted); font-size: 17px; margin-bottom: 10px; }

    /* Search */
    .search-container { position: relative; max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .search-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 16px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      color: var(--muted);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .search-input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px 44px 14px 48px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-family: inherit;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--surface-border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      color: var(--ink);
      outline: none;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .search-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }
    .search-input:focus {
      background: var(--surface-hover);
      border-color: var(--ink);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.20);
    }
    .search-clear {
      position: absolute;
      right: 12px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border: none;
      border-radius: 50%;
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--muted);
      padding: 0;
    }
    .search-clear.visible { display: flex; }
    .search-clear:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); color: var(--ink); }

    /* Live Search Results */
    .live-search-results { max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 32px 24px 64px; display: none; }
    .live-search-results.active { display: block; }
    .live-search-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .live-search-title { font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); }
    .live-search-title strong { color: var(--ink); }
    .live-search-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .live-search-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 18px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--surface-border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .live-search-item:hover {
      background: var(--surface-hover);
      border-color: var(--surface-border);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    .live-search-item-icon {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      background: var(--surface-hover);
      border: 1px solid var(--surface-border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--ink);
    }
    .live-search-item-content { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .live-search-item-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .live-search-item-category { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 6px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
    .live-search-item-excerpt { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }

    .live-search-no-results { text-align: center; padding: 64px 24px; }
    .live-search-no-results-icon {
      width: 64px; height: 64px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--surface-border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .live-search-no-results h3 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .live-search-no-results p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); }

    .container.searching { display: none; }

    /* Main Content */
    .container { max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 8px 24px 80px; }

    /* Category Grid */
    .categories-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 280px), 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 48px; }
    .category-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--surface-border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 24px;
      min-width: 0;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .category-card:hover {
      background: var(--surface-hover);
      border-color: var(--surface-border);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .category-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .category-icon {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      background: var(--surface-hover);
      border: 1px solid var(--surface-border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
    }
    .category-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink); }
    .category-count { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .category-articles { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
    .article-link {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      background: var(--surface-hover);
      border-radius: 8px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .article-link:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: var(--ink); }
    .article-link-icon { color: var(--muted); flex-shrink: 0; }
    .article-link-text { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .view-all-link {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 12px; padding: 8px 0;
      font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .view-all-link:hover { opacity: 0.8; transform: translateX(3px); }

    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    const searchClear = document.getElementById('searchClear');
    const liveSearchResults = document.getElementById('liveSearchResults');
    const categoriesContainer = document.getElementById('categoriesContainer');

    let debounceTimer;

    function performSearch(query) {
      query = query.toLowerCase().trim();

      // Show/hide clear button
      if (query.length > 0) {
        searchClear.classList.add('visible');
      } else {
        searchClear.classList.remove('visible');
      }

      // If no query, show categories and hide search results
      if (query.length === 0) {
        liveSearchResults.classList.remove('active');
        categoriesContainer.classList.remove('searching');
        return;
      }

      // Hide categories and show search results
      categoriesContainer.classList.add('searching');
      liveSearchResults.classList.add('active');

      // Filter articles
      const results = articles.filter(article => {
        return article.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
               article.excerpt.toLowerCase().includes(query);
      });

      // Render results
      if (results.length === 0) {
        liveSearchResults.innerHTML = `
          <div class="live-search-no-results">
            <div class="live-search-no-results-icon">
              <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle>
                <path d="m21 21-4.35-4.35"></path>
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h3>No results found</h3>
            <p>Try a different search term or browse the categories below.</p>
          </div>
        `;
      } else {
        liveSearchResults.innerHTML = `
          <div class="live-search-header">
            <span class="live-search-title"><strong>${results.length}</strong> article${results.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} found</span>
          </div>
          <div class="live-search-list">
            ${results.map(article => `
              <a href="/help/${article.slug}" class="live-search-item">
                <div class="live-search-item-icon">
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <path d="M14.5 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V7.5L14.5 2z"></path>
                    <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"></polyline>
                  </svg>
                </div>
                <div class="live-search-item-content">
                  <div class="live-search-item-title">${highlightMatch(article.title, query)}</div>
                  <div class="live-search-item-category">${article.category}</div>
                  ${article.excerpt ? `<div class="live-search-item-excerpt">${article.excerpt}</div>` : ''}
                </div>
              </a>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        `;
      }
    }

    function highlightMatch(text, query) {
      const regex = new RegExp(`(${escapeRegex(query)})`, 'gi');
      return text.replace(regex, '<mark style="background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); color: var(--ink); padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 4px;">$1</mark>');
    }

    function escapeRegex(str) {
      return str.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
    }

    function clearSearch() {
      searchInput.value = '';
      searchClear.classList.remove('visible');
      liveSearchResults.classList.remove('active');
      categoriesContainer.classList.remove('searching');
      searchInput.focus();
    }

    // Debounced search on input
    searchInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
      clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        performSearch(this.value);
      }, 100);
    });

    // Clear button click
    searchClear.addEventListener('click', clearSearch);

    // Keyboard navigation
    searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (this.value) {
          clearSearch();
        } else {
          searchInput.blur();
        }
      }
    });

    const browser = document.getElementById('all');
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    const category = params.get('category');
    const initialQuery = params.get('q');
    function showBrowser() { browser.hidden = false; }
    if (category) {
      showBrowser();
      document.getElementById('browserTitle').textContent = category;
      const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.article-card'));
      const matching = cards.filter(card => card.dataset.category === category);
      if (matching.length) cards.forEach(card => { card.hidden = card.dataset.category !== category; });
      else { searchInput.value = category; performSearch(category); }
    }
    if (initialQuery) { showBrowser(); searchInput.value = initialQuery; performSearch(initialQuery); }
    if (location.hash === '#all') showBrowser();
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', function() { if (location.hash === '#all') showBrowser(); });
    document.querySelector('.topics-heading a').addEventListener('click', function() {
      showBrowser();
      document.getElementById('browserTitle').textContent = 'All articles';
      document.querySelectorAll('.article-card').forEach(card => { card.hidden = false; });
      searchInput.value = '';
      performSearch('');
      history.replaceState(null, '', '/help#all');
    });
    const menu = document.querySelector('.menu-toggle');
    menu.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const open = document.getElementById('headerLinks').classList.toggle('open');
      menu.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    });
    const heroMessage = document.getElementById('heroMessage');
    function sendHero(message) {
      if (!message.trim() || !window.HypertaskHelp) return;
      window.HypertaskHelp.open({ message: message.trim() });
      heroMessage.value = '';
    }
    document.getElementById('heroChat').addEventListener('submit', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); sendHero(heroMessage.value); });
    heroMessage.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !e.isComposing) { e.preventDefault(); sendHero(heroMessage.value); } });
    document.querySelectorAll('.suggestions-home button').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', function() { sendHero(button.dataset.message); }));
    document.getElementById('heroAttach').addEventListener('click', function() { document.getElementById('heroFile').click(); });
    document.getElementById('heroFile').addEventListener('change', function() {
      const file = this.files[0];
      if (!file || !file.type.startsWith('image/')) return;
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function() { if (window.HypertaskHelp) window.HypertaskHelp.open({ attachment: reader.result }); };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      this.value = '';
    });

    const libraryView = document.getElementById('libraryView');
    const reader = document.getElementById('reader');
    const readerBody = document.getElementById('readerBody');
    let readerSlug = '';

    function escapeReaderText(value) {
      return String(value || '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&')
        .replace(/</g, '<')
        .replace(/>/g, '>')
        .replace(/"/g, '"');
    }

    function closeReader() {
      reader.hidden = true;
      libraryView.hidden = false;
      readerSlug = '';
      document.body.classList.remove('reading');
    }

    function helpSlugFromLink(anchor) {
      if (!anchor || anchor.target === '_blank') return null;
      let url;
      try { url = new URL(anchor.getAttribute('href') || '', window.location.origin); }
      catch (err) { return null; }
      if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return null;
      const match = url.pathname.match(/^\/help\/([^/]+)\/?$/);
      return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
    }

    async function openArticle(slug) {
      if (!slug) return;
      readerSlug = slug;
      reader.hidden = false;
      document.body.classList.add('reading');
      if (window.innerWidth >= 900) libraryView.hidden = true;
      readerBody.innerHTML = '<p class="reader-loading">Loading article…</p>';
      reader.scrollTop = 0;
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/help-reader/' + encodeURIComponent(slug));
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('missing');
        const data = await res.json();
        if (readerSlug !== slug) return;
        const known = articles.find(function(item) { return item.slug === data.slug; });
        const category = known ? known.category : '';
        readerBody.innerHTML =
          '<header class="article-header">' +
          (category ? '<span class="article-category">' + escapeReaderText(category) + '</span>' : '') +
          '<h1 class="article-title">' + escapeReaderText(data.title) + '</h1>' +
          (data.plansHtml || '') +
          (data.excerpt ? '<p class="article-excerpt">' + escapeReaderText(data.excerpt) + '</p>' : '') +
          '</header><div class="content">' + (data.html || '') + '</div>';
      } catch (err) {
        if (readerSlug === slug) {
          readerBody.innerHTML = '<p class="reader-loading">That article could not be opened.</p>';
        }
      }
    }

    document.getElementById('readerBack').addEventListener('click', closeReader);

    function onHelpLinkClick(e) {
      const slug = helpSlugFromLink(e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a') : null);
      if (!slug) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      openArticle(slug);
    }
    document.getElementById('helpMain').addEventListener('click', onHelpLinkClick);
    document.getElementById('reader').addEventListener('click', onHelpLinkClick);

    window.addEventListener('message', function(e) {
      if (e.origin !== window.location.origin) return;
      if (!e.data || e.data.type !== 'help-open-article' || !e.data.slug) return;
      openArticle(e.data.slug);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && reader && !reader.hidden) {
        closeReader();
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      if (reader.hidden) return;
      libraryView.hidden = window.innerWidth >= 900;
    });
  </script>

          header.classList.add('scrolled');

          header.classList.remove('scrolled');
